chunks: 993 - And the meaning of the report that was narrated is: “The faqih does not repeat the prayer.”

key_terms.الْخَبَرِ: the report or hadith being explained
key_terms.الْفَقِيهَ: the jurist; one possessing fiqh and legal understanding
key_terms.مَعْنَى: the meaning or intended sense of the report

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith “the faqih does not repeat the prayer” mean?
ai.summary: This passage explains the meaning of a reported hadith stating that the faqih does not repeat the prayer. It pertains to jurisprudential understanding of prayer and the rulings of forgetfulness in salat.
